cohort: 89 pregnant women with preeclampsia (30 mild, 48 severe, 11 superimposed) at Enrique Cabrera hospital from January 1st, 2010 to December 31st, 2011.
finding: While cesarean delivery was high in all preeclampsia groups, the mean birth weight was significantly lower in the severe preeclampsia group.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was high in all groups, mainly in severe preeclampsia (93.8%).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly lower in the severe preeclampsia group (2451g).
